data.name: Pet Chamber
data.detailed_description:
You're locked together in a truck on a constant run from a swarm that eats everything on its way. Bound by deadly symbiosis, you need each other to survive. Will you reach shelter before you’ll be consumed by a force that ended the world?

“Pet Chamber” is an experimental horror management game in which the player must fulfill the monster’s needs. The monster produces biofuel to power the truck. The truck is in terrible shape and requires constant repairs.

Features

  • Monster care mechanics — the monster must survive. Without it, the truck will stop. Feed it, clean it, keep it calm, healthy, and sane. Most importantly: don’t let it kill you.

  • Exploration — look around the truck to find clues and useful items.

  • Multiple Endings - depending on your actions your journey might end in a more or less favorable way.

  • Retro aesthetic - hand crafted, human made low poly retro graphics tailored to create a dark atmosphere.

Something is not right about this monster. It knows you better than you think. It knows what you’ve done. Did you forget? Will you uncover the truth about the Pet Chamber? To do so, you’ll have to dig deeper and look for clues.

data.short_description: Welded inside a rusty, devastated truck, you travel through the apocalypse—accompanied by a monster that wants you dead. The monster provides Matter; Matter provides fuel and supplies. You need each other to survive. Feed it, avoid being killed, survive the end of the world—or die trying.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Any dualcore should work
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 (any with Vulkan support)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Motherboard integrated sound card (nothing to worry, your PC should have it)

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Steam OS 3.7.23
  • Processor: Any dualcore should work
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 (any with Vulkan support)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Motherboard integrated sound card (nothing to worry, your PC should have it)

content_descriptors.notes: Retro low poly stylized gore and violence.
